requirements.quote: ±3%. Sources shall not produce 800 VDC plus 10%, and setpoints shall stay below 1500 VDC
requirements.text: Sources must not exceed 800 VDC plus 10%, and setpoints must stay below 1500 VDC.

requirements.quote: DC grounding shall be IT, floating or high-resistance, with detection and protection coordinated across the 800 VDC system
requirements.text: DC grounding must be IT, floating, or high-resistance, with coordinated detection and protection.

requirements.quote: Overload shall be 150% for 150 ms in constant-current mode and 120% for 5 s in constant-voltage mode, with output DC link capacitance of at most 10 mF per 4 MW
requirements.text: Overload specifications and DC link capacitance limits are defined.

requirements.quote: Efficiency shall be at least 98% between 50% and 100% utilization, counting power train loss only
requirements.text: Efficiency must be at least 98% between 50% and 100% utilization.

requirements.quote: Blocks shall support fast shutdown by shunt trip and internal disconnect, and shall limit DC fault current with a current-limiting stage
requirements.text: Blocks must support fast shutdown and limit DC fault current.

requirements.quote: Outdoor enclosures shall be NEMA 3R, rated ·30 to 40 °C with derating stated above 40 °C, corrosion class C5, seismic design category D and 120 mph wind, with a design life of 15 years or more within a 10 to 20 ft by 8 ft by 8.5 ft envelope
requirements.text: Outdoor enclosures must meet specific environmental and design standards.

requirements.quote: Each block shall report a state machine of off, standby, precharged, on, fault and warning over Modbus TCP/IP. A permanent failure shall require manual validation, service and reset before the block returns to on
requirements.text: Blocks must report state machine statuses and require manual validation after permanent failure.

requirements.quote: Auxiliary power shall come from 480 Vac backed by the data center UPS, plus an internal source
requirements.text: Auxiliary power must be sourced from 480 Vac backed by UPS and an internal source.

requirements.quote: Major blocks shall be built from sub-blocks that can be swapped live
requirements.text: Major blocks must be constructed from live-swappable sub-blocks.

requirements.quote: Equipment shall comply with NFPA 70 and 70E, UL 347A, UL 508C, UL 840, UL 1741, IEEE 519, IEEE 1547 and IEEE 1584
requirements.text: Equipment must comply with specified standards.

requirements.quote: Bidders shall state product maturity and field references for the offered input class. Commercial SSTs are mostly 15 kV-class, so an SST proposal for a higher class shall show type-test evidence
requirements.text: Bidders must provide product maturity and field references, and type-test evidence for higher-class SSTs.

requirements.quote: Lot 2 includes the 15 kV-class switchgear lineups at each deployment unit that feed the power blocks, built to L1.04 to L1.06
requirements.text: Lot 2 includes 15 kV-class switchgear lineups built to specified standards.

requirements.quote: 800 VDC two-wire distribution shall run from the power-block output through DC switchboards and 6000 A-class busduct to parallel 1250 A row busways with 125 A tap cans
requirements.text: 800 VDC distribution must follow specified routing and capacity standards.

requirements.quote: Each deployment unit shall use a 4+1 block-redundant arrangement with a DC static transfer switch, built from semiconductor OR-ing or adjustable DC/DC catcher paths
requirements.text: Deployment units must use a 4+1 block-redundant arrangement with specified DC static transfer switch.

requirements.quote: The design shall reach 99.9% availability. Because DC distribution allows no UPS-style maintenance bypass, redundancy shall sit at power-block level and, where needed, at distribution level, and a catcher shall protect the conversion block from single points of failure
requirements.text: Design must achieve 99.9% availability with redundancy and protection against single points of failure.

requirements.quote: Operation shall stay inside the voltage band: no setpoint above 1500 VDC, no average above 1500 VDC, no extended excursion above it, and 840 VDC as the overvoltage disconnect hinge
requirements.text: Operation must stay within specified voltage band limits.

requirements.quote: Earthing shall be TN-S or IT. Bidders shall propose high-resistance midpoint, high-resistance return, floating or solid grounding, with fault-current, detection and personnel-safety analysis
requirements.text: Earthing must be TN-S or IT, with specified grounding proposals and safety analysis.

requirements.quote: Multiple solid earth points shall be avoided, and the potential drop between housings and the central earth point shall stay below 200 mV
requirements.text: Avoid multiple solid earth points; potential drop must stay below 200 mV.

requirements.quote: IT systems shall have insulation monitoring that detects a first ground fault, with impedance typically above 100 ohm per volt DC
requirements.text: IT systems must have insulation monitoring for first ground fault detection.

requirements.quote: Protection shall use two zones: facility distribution, from source output to tap-can input, with insulation monitoring and fast source shutdown on overcurrent, and the rack interface, from tap can to rack, with residual current monitoring
requirements.text: Protection must use two zones with specified monitoring and shutdown features.

requirements.quote: Tap-can branch protection shall be an MCCB or a solid-state breaker. Bidders shall state clearing times and the redundancy or holdup that covers a clearing time of up to about 20 ms
requirements.text: Tap-can branch protection must use MCCB or solid-state breakers, with clearing times and redundancy stated.

requirements.quote: Solid-state breakers shall target 125 A air-cooled ratings for 800 V to 54 V shelves and 1250 A liquid-cooled ratings for native 800 VDC racks
requirements.text: Solid-state breakers must meet specified ratings for air-cooled and liquid-cooled applications.

requirements.quote: Series arcing shall be mitigated with connector temperature monitoring and high-frequency sensing at the
requirements.text: Series arcing must be mitigated using specified monitoring and sensing methods.
